**Docker Image**: ghcr.io/doitintl/kube-no-trouble:latest

### Changelog 

#### Features:

- feat: Add rego for v1.32 deprecations [b4da33a](https://github.com/doitintl/kube-no-trouble/commit/b4da33a06c19a68849001313ce9db810483d1acb) by @dark0dave
- feat: Fix github actions for creating release notes [edd2dc3](https://github.com/doitintl/kube-no-trouble/commit/edd2dc36ce637990cfb97591cec740b3eb74a763) by @dark0dave

#### Fixes:

- fix: Script install.sh in dumb TERM [35927e8](https://github.com/doitintl/kube-no-trouble/commit/35927e87bd33f85473acec1da28e00abf0e7b057) by @FabioAntunes
- fix: warn and fix invalid namespace [83308e1](https://github.com/doitintl/kube-no-trouble/commit/83308e16a0de98e22fc1037afe73f4cf59541e9b) by @justdan96
- fix: Add docker image back [6de101d](https://github.com/doitintl/kube-no-trouble/commit/6de101d57f5eddd1fe30ad9e7496962e7596c1ec) by @dark0dave
- fix: Add fix for git cliff [9d487c9](https://github.com/doitintl/kube-no-trouble/commit/9d487c96a27adb90f45f3a657c757a87e8245465) by @dark0dave

#### Internal/Other:

- dep: Bump lots of deps [7cdf86a](https://github.com/doitintl/kube-no-trouble/commit/7cdf86ab6464e6d49568063ff8182ded0439c7cf) by @dark0dave

Full Changelog: [0.7.2...0.7.3](https://github.com/doitintl/kube-no-trouble/compare/0.7.2...0.7.3)
### New Contributors

* @justdan96 made their first contribution in #594
* @FabioAntunes made their first contribution in #587
